title: Length and avoidance of the stage witness
statement: Let $N$ be a sequence of finite oracle Turing machines, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $d$ be stage data. The witness selected for this stage is a Boolean string of length $	ext{freshLen}(i,d.	ext{bound})$ that does not occur among the queries made by the $i$th machine during this stage.
